title: Per-test kept-red expectation manifest for a paired red proof
description: A versioned JSON file sitting next to a paired red proof test, named <proof-file>.expected-red.json. Read by apps/front/scripts/ci/run-preuves.mts. Each test declared in `expectedRed` MUST fail on correct code. If a declared kept-red test PASSES, the runner fails CI with verdict CORRUPT PROOF. The runner refuses to classify if this file is missing, invalid JSON, or the test list is empty.

testName.description: The exact test() name declared in the proof file. Matched by suffix/equality against vitest's assertionResults[].fullName.

why.description: Human-readable justification for why this test MUST fail. Surfaced in the runner's CORRUPT PROOF output.
